description: Split one image into an Instagram profile grid, numbered in posting order (post tile 01 first: Instagram shows the newest post top-left, so the bottom-right tile goes first), or into carousel slides that line up seamlessly as people swipe. Presets: ig-row, ig-grid-2, ig-grid-3, ig-grid-4 (3 columns, 3:4 tiles), ig-grid-sq (3×3 square), ig-grid-45 (3×2, 4:5; the default), ig-pano-2, ig-pano-3, ig-pano-5 (4:5 carousels), ig-pano-sq, li-carousel (square), tiktok, story-pano (9:16). Any setting given overrides the preset. Saved in a new folder next to the image. [Pro tool.]

file.description: The image to split. ~ is your home folder.

focus_x.description: Which part to keep when the image’s shape doesn’t match: 0 left, 50 centre, 100 right.

mode.description: "grid": a profile grid of tiles. "carousel": slides side by side.

output_dir.description: Where to put the folder of tiles. Default: next to the image.

preset.description: A ready layout (see the description). Default ig-grid-45, or the plain grid/carousel when mode is given.

shape.description: Each tile or slide’s shape: 1:1 square, 4:5 portrait post, 3:4 (current Instagram profile thumbnails), 9:16 story.

tile_width.description: Width of each tile or slide in pixels; the height follows the shape.

name: grid_slide
title: Grid & Slide
